bdems.insider_is_by_design: B-DEMS authorises destruction by the Sender's enrolled role and carries no court signature, so a Sender destroying on its own TxE is indistinguishable from a court-ordered destruction
bdems.verifier: Algorithm 3 Step 3 / §3.4.2: destructionOf(EID) read from the chain, a TxE exists, status destroyed, and SHA-256(keccak256(TxE as presented) ‖ H(E′)) equals the recorded confirmation

ours.verifier: verify_redaction (eq:validredact) for valid, insider, modified and replay; the auditor's account() for no_record

method.bdems: Algorithm 3 per evidence item: TxE, overwrite-and-unlink, confirmation hash SHA-256(keccak256(TxE) || H(E')) by the TxE's Sender; one Sender, every transaction of a batch submitted at once
method.evidence_keywords: type, device, collector, and the 25 range ancestors of the acquisition hour
method.gas: receipt gasUsed: ours orderRedaction + commitRoot of the redaction epoch; B-DEMS every TxE and confirmation
method.latency: first transaction submitted to the last one included, erasure done in between; ours excludes the epoch wait (up to Delta) and the court's signing of the order
method.ours: SAC Phase 5 over Pi_core: orderRedaction included, the gate reading the recorded digest, execute_core, one DISPOSE per capsule from the Secure Module, the order leaf and the DISPOSE segments anchored in their own epoch with M = 2 of N = 3 ML-DSA approvals and the SLH-DSA co-signature
method.warm_up: one redaction per system per case size, discarded
